name: CREATE USER with empty or weak password
attack_scenario: A network-reachable DB has an account created IDENTIFIED BY 'password'; an automated scanner brute-forces it in one guess and gets an authenticated foothold, from which it enumerates schemas and pivots.
negative_test_hint: run "CREATE USER 'app'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'password';" and assert it is rejected in favor of a generated secret and a restricted host

exemplar.explanation: CWE-521/CWE-258: accounts created with an empty string or a top-list password (password, admin, 123456, changeme...) are trivially guessable and are the first thing credential-stuffing and default-credential scanners try. Committed .sql seed scripts also leak the literal into version control.
